mapper.select: WITH date_expand AS ( SELECT r.id, r.rent_type, r.rent_start_time + (tn.n - 1) AS rent_date FROM dwd_vehicle_car_rent_apply r JOIN dwd_vehicle_rent_day tn ON tn.n <= rent_days WHERE r.rent_start_time <= #{maxDay} AND r.rent_end_time >= #{minDay} AND r.instance_status = '已完成' AND r.approve_result ='同意' ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM date_expand WHERE rent_date <= #{maxDay} AND rent_date >= #{minDay}

WITH date_expand AS ( SELECT r.id, r.rent_type, r.rent_start_time + (tn.n - 1) AS rent_date FROM dwd_vehicle_car_rent_apply r JOIN dwd_vehicle_rent_day tn ON tn.n <= rent_days WHERE r.rent_start_time <= #{maxDay} AND r.rent_end_time >= #{minDay} AND r.instance_status = '已完成' AND r.approve_result ='同意' ) SELECT rent_type AS rentType, count(*) AS count FROM date_expand WHERE rent_date <= #{maxDay} AND rent_date >= #{minDay} GROUP BY rent_type

WITH date_expand AS ( SELECT r.id, r.rent_type, r.rent_start_time + (tn.n - 1) AS rent_date FROM dwd_vehicle_car_rent_apply r JOIN dwd_vehicle_rent_day tn ON tn.n <= rent_days WHERE r.rent_start_time <= #{maxDay} AND r.rent_end_time >= #{minDay} AND r.instance_status = '已完成' AND r.approve_result ='同意' ) SELECT TO_CHAR(rent_date, #{timeType}) AS date, count(*) AS count FROM date_expand WHERE rent_date <= #{maxDay} AND rent_date >= #{minDay} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(rent_date, #{timeType})
